Summarize Simulation Results

Source: R/spatial_prediction.R
summary.RiskMap_assess_simulation.Rd

Summarizes the results of model evaluations from a RiskMap_assess_simulation object. Provides average metrics for classification by category and overall correct classification (CC) summary.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_assess_simulation'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class RiskMap_assess_simulation, as returned by assess_simulation.

...

Additional arguments (not used).

Value

A list of class summary.RiskMap_assess_simulation with one element per assessed spatial scale (grid and/or area), each holding:

  • mse: a data frame with, for each model, the number of simulations (n_sim), the number with a result (n_valid), and the mean and standard deviation of the MSE across simulations (MSE_mean, MSE_sd);

  • classify: for each model, classify_res, the average sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV and CC by category across simulations, n_valid, the number of simulations with a defined value of each metric, n_sim, and cc_summary, the mean, standard deviation and 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of the overall proportion of correct classification.

It also holds fits, the number of model fits and of failed fits.
